title: A Neural Network Approach towards Real-Time Knot Point Density Estimates for the Nonlinear Quadrotor
abstract: arXiv:2610.42027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spline representations provide a compact way to approximate continuous trajectories using a finite number of parameters. When approximating trajectories generated by dynamical systems, the efficiency of a spline representation depends strongly on the placement of knot points. Uniform knot distributions often lead to inefficient representations, requiring either unnecessary control points or producing poor approximations in regions where the trajectory varies rapidly. In this work we propose a learning-based method for adaptive knot placement in B-spline approximations of trajectories generated by ordinary differential equations. A neural network learns a mapping from the initial condition of the system to quantities that characterize the local variation of the resulting trajectory. translated_title: 面向非线性四旋翼实时节点密度估计的神经网络方法
translated_abstract: 样条表示提供了一种使用有限数量参数来逼近连续轨迹的紧凑方法。当逼近由动力学系统生成的轨迹时，样条表示的效率在很大程度上取决于节点的放置位置。均匀的节点分布通常会导致低效的表示，要么需要不必要的控制点，要么在轨迹变化迅速的区域产生较差的逼近效果。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于学习的方法，用于对常微分方程生成的轨迹进行B样条逼近时的自适应节点放置。神经网络学习从系统初始条件到刻画所得轨迹局部变化的量的映射。这些估计值被用于构建非均匀节点分布，该分布近似等分布局部误差指标，从而减少控制点的数量。
tldr: 提出一种神经网络方法，通过学习系统初始条件与轨迹局部变化之间的映射来实现B样条逼近中的自适应节点放置，从而实时估计非线性四旋翼轨迹所需的节点密度并有效减少控制点数量。
